description: Accessiboss read-only API keys (Scale and Agency plans). action list (default; name, prefix, created, last used, expiry; the secret is never shown again), create (name; confirm; the secret is returned once in the confirmed result, store it at once), revoke (keyId from list; confirm). A key can only read sites, scans and issues under /api/accessiboss/v1/sites, 60 requests a minute, and only for this account.

action.description: list is default. create and revoke need confirm; the secret of a new key is shown once.

keyId.description: revoke: key id from action list.

name.description: create: what the key is for.

name: oma_accessiboss_api_keys
title: Accessiboss API keys
